$comment: Settings for SharePointGovernance/tools/build_solution.py --root solutions/SharePointNews. Bump 'version' for every release you import.
description: Expiry, weekly port roundup and urgent notice flows for the HPUK News and Other News sites.

HPUKNewsSiteUrl.description: Full URL of the HPUK News communication site. Comms Distribution and Delivery Log live here.

OtherNewsSiteUrl.description: Full URL of the Other News communication site.

CommsSenderMailbox.description: Shared mailbox the roundup and urgent emails are sent from. The flow identity needs Send As on it.

CommsTeamEmail.description: Where notices about skipped urgent alerts (audience-targeted, no destination) and delivery failures go.

SupportOwnerEmail.description: Operational support owner for the news flows (Nigel Bell): receives failure alerts.

UrgentPublisherEmails.description: Semicolon-separated addresses of the people allowed to send urgent notices (Chloe, Rachel and Toby). Urgent posts by anyone else are not sent.

DispatchEnabled.description: Master switch for outbound email and Teams posts from the roundup and urgent flows. No (the default) means they send nothing. Set to Yes only once the Comms Distribution rows have been tested; set back to No to stop all sending at once.

ExpiryWritesEnabled.description: Lets C1 set Status to Expired. No (the default) runs C1 as a dry run that emails the support owner the pages it would have expired. Set to Yes once expiry has been proven on a test page.

UrgentGoLiveDate.description: Urgent alerts are only sent for posts first published on or after this date and time, e.g. 2026-11-02T00:00:00Z, so editing an older or migrated post never sends an alert. Set it once at go-live and don't move it. The default (2099) sends nothing.
